acceptanceCriteria: OpenCode 2.1.x passes the live qualification and the supported range admits it, or the refusal records a measured incompatibility.
body: Observed 2026-10-21 lane gh1406-1021r (PR #1501): /opt/homebrew/bin/opencode 2.1.1 refused as unsupported; the lane fell back to 2.0.18. Extend the range after qualifying 2.1.x.
title: OpenCode qualification refuses installed OpenCode 2.1.1: supported range is >=2.0.18 <2.1.0
